name: answer-vectors
description: Answer canonicalisation (C 20.1, C 20.3). canonical: raw input from the learning panel -> the one canonical string sent in SUBMIT_ATTEMPT, or a refusal (no op is created). MULTIPLE_CHOICE (Phase 11), PICTURE_SELECT and NUMBER_SELECT (Phase 37), OBJECT_MOVE, ARRANGE and TYPED (Phase 38). Choice types carry optionIds; NUMBER_SELECT carries values; OBJECT_MOVE carries mode and zoneIds, sourceCount, requireAllPlaced (DISTRIBUTE; input zone -> count) or objectIds, binIds (SORT; input object -> bin); ARRANGE carries mode, tiles {id, value} and slots (input: the tile ID in each space); TYPED carries mode, maxLength and caseSensitive (input: the text typed). twoStep: steps (each a spec as above) and one raw input per step -> the step answers joined by |. shape: what the Python side checks (one string of at most 64 characters, allowed characters only); every canonical output above must also pass it.
sources: C 20.1 (MULTIPLE_CHOICE and PICTURE_SELECT: the option ID; NUMBER_SELECT and TYPED NUMERIC: decimal integer, no sign, no leading zeros; OBJECT_MOVE: id=value pairs sorted by ID joined by ;; ARRANGE: tile values; TYPED WORD: explicit whitespace, apostrophe, hyphen and A-Z steps; no trim, Number() or case folding)
spine S3.3 and S9.5 (one string of at most 64 characters; reserved separators)
